description: This file defines an Android BroadcastReceiver class 'IncomingCallReceiver' that listens for incoming SIP calls, handles incoming call events, answers calls, and manages call audio settings within a SIP-based VoIP application.

classes.name: IncomingCallReceiver
classes.description: An Android BroadcastReceiver that intercepts incoming SIP calls, answers them, and initiates call audio management.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming SIP call intents, answers calls, manages audio, and updates the activity with call status.
